subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four parts. Identify the part that contains an error.

(A) Four divided by / (B) two is coming / (C) out to / (D) be two.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the phrase "**is coming**" in part (B).
 
• Since the sentence discusses a** mathematical fact**, it should use the **simple present tense.**
 
• The correct phrase should be "**is**" instead of "**is coming**," ensuring **grammatical accuracy and clarity.**
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part B** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **B**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Four divided by two **is** two."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "Four divided by" ** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **C: "out to" ** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **D: "be two." ** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
